text:
Noelle: Quick one  flying into Palo Alto next week, staying by University Ave. Any good vegan brunch spots? Prefer casual seating.
Hank: I like Cafe Probiotic on California Ave for vegan options, but it's a short drive from Univ Ave.
Priya: Try Crepe & Leaf for savory vegan crepes, or The Veggie Grill near Stanford for reliable bowls.
Noelle: Thanks! also: any late-night-ish coffee near the office for a 10pm work session?
Hank: Chromatic Coffee on University sometimes open late for events, but double-check. There's a 24hr espresso at the gas station on Embarcadero if desperate.
Priya: If you want bakery + coffee in morning, Joanie's Bakery opens early and has almond croissants (vegan options on request).
Noelle: Perfect. Switching contexts  Lisbon travel recs? arriving in afternoon, want seafood and a casual pastel de nata spot.
Hank: For seafood in Alfama, try Canto da Vila. For pastéis, Manteigaria is the go-to (fresh out the oven).
Priya: Time your pastel stop mid-afternoon before lines. For a casual tasca, try Taberna da Rua das Flores.
Noelle: Awesome. Back to HQ logistics  who wants to split a bakery run tomorrow 11:45? @Hank @Priya react with :white_check_mark: if in.
Hank: :white_check_mark: will grab 6 items.
Priya: :white_check_mark: can bring napkins and utensils.
snack-bot: Note added: "Bakery run - 11:45 tomorrow"  pinned to #lunch-plans.
Noelle: I'll drop $15 in the shared lunch fund and DM details. Thanks! :raised_hands:
